'''Ryleel Imperial Base''', or simply '''Ryleel Base''', was a base of the [[Galactic Empire]] located on [[Carida]]. After being moved into active duty in the [[Imperial Navy]], [[Bansu Ro]] and [[Rac Syrmo]], [[Imperial cadet|cadets]] at [[Carida Academy]], were sent from Ryleel Base to meet with the [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]].

==Description==
Ryleel Imperial Base,<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" /> also known as just Ryleel Base,<ref name="TIE Fighter 4" /> was a base operated by the [[Galactic Empire]] on the<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" /> [[Colonies]]<ref name="Timelines">{{GalaxyMapPoster}}</ref> [[planet]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> [[Carida]].<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" /> It was made up of multiple buildings and a landing area for [[starship]]s like [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]].<ref name="TIE Fighter 4" /> Among the buildings were an infirmary and a repair room.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" />

==History==
Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date 1">The events of [[Bounty Hunters 25|''Bounty Hunters'' 25]] take place after the [[Escape from Cloud City]] and before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]], which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> [[Beilert Valance]],<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" /> a [[cyborg]] [[mercenary]] working for the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] under blackmail,<ref name="Bounty Hunters 18">[[Bounty Hunters 18|''Bounty Hunters'' 18]]</ref> received repairs to his [[cybernetics]] at Ryleel Base after rescuing seventeen Imperial [[engineer]]s from a sabotage attack by a [[Crimson Dawn]] mole. The engineers were meanwhile tended to at the infirmary nearby. Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Jyala Haydenn]] visited Valance and commended his heroic actions to save the engineers, taking him to the seventeen injured Imperials.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" />

While the engineers crowded Valance and thanked him, Haydenn was informed by an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Ryleel Imperial Base)|Imperial officer]] that a [[Yuralla Vega|loved]] [[Cadeliah|ones]] of Valance's, who's safety assurance was being used to blackmail the cyborg, was suspected to have been [[Death|killed]] in an [[Battle of Panisia|Imperial attack]]. Haydenn told the [[officer]] that the information stayed between the pair of them in order to ensure Valance's loyalty.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" />

Around 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="Date 2">The events of the [[TIE Fighter 4|fourth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (comic series)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] take place shortly before the events of the [[TIE Fighter 5|fifth issue]]. Since the fifth issue ends shortly after the [[Battle of Endor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[4 ABY]], the fourth issue must therefore take place around that [[Standard year|year]].</ref> a class of [[Imperial cadet]]s at the [[Carida Academy|Imperial Naval Academy]] on Carida was comandeered by the [[Imperial Navy]] for its war effort. The top two ranking [[cadet]]s, [[Bansu Ro]] and [[Rac Syrmo]], were requested by the Empire's [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing]] and took a ''Lambda''-class [[shuttle]] from Ryleel Base to meet with their new [[Squadron Five (Shadow Wing)|squadron]].<ref name="TIE Fighter 4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryleel Base first appeared in the [[TIE Fighter 4|fourth]] issue of the [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (comic series)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series, written by [[Jody Houser]], penciled by [[Rogê Antônio]] and [[Ig Guara]],<ref name="TIE Fighter 4" /> and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[July 17]], [[2019]].<ref name="Marvel TF4">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/75575/star_wars_tie_fighter_2019_4|text=Star Wars: Tie Fighter (2019) #4}}</ref> It was then identified as Ryleel Imperial Base when it reappeared in the [[Bounty Hunters 25|twenty-fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunters]]'' comic series, written by [[Ethan Sacks]], pencilled by [[Paolo Villanelli]],<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" /> and published by Marvel Comics on [[July 13]], [[2022]].<ref name="Marvel BH25">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/98318/star_wars_bounty_hunters_2020_25|text=Star Wars: Bounty Hunters (2020) #25}}</ref> While not confirmed by ''TIE Fighter'' 4,<ref name="TIE Fighter 4" /> [[Wookieepedia]] assumed Ryleel Base to be on Carida upon the creation of the former subjects page in [[2020]],<ref name="Ryleel Revision">{{WookCite|url=Ryleel_Imperial_Base?oldid=8770335|text=10 January 2020 revision of the "Ryleel Base" article}}</ref> a detail that was later [[canon]]ically confirmed by ''Bounty Hunters'' 25.<ref name="Bounty Hunters 25" />
